sessionEnd: Regular continuous-session close: 15:00 before 2024-11-05; 15:30 afterwards. Lunch excluded from expected slots; no overnight. Auction prints are not regular 5m bars. Last completed regular close is reference only, not auction execution.
strictPath: Require every expected 5m bucket. Sparse observed-minute buckets retained per unchanged normalizer and disclosed. Missing horizon unavailable, no imputation. No eligibility use for Entry.
excursions: Gross price percent from frozen Entry reference; MFE floored at zero and MAE capped at zero. Earliest bar attaining global extremum; reported time is completion-time upper bound, not tick-level time.
ordering: Positive MFE and negative MAE required; distinct extrema bars order known at bar resolution; same bar UNKNOWN_INTRABAR_ORDER; if either excursion absent NO_TWO_SIDED_EXCURSION.
recovery: For each strict30m adverse cohort, first threshold-hit bar excluded from later MFE; subsequent bars only through same complete horizon. Recovery = later HIGH returns >=0; separately later +1 and horizon close return. Session-end comparison only on complete session paths.

pathTypes.horizon: Complete session-end path required; first >=+1 or <=-1 crossings; first15m early; 30m fast; priority A,B,D,C,E,F,G. Thresholds diagnostic user-provided levels, not optimized EXIT.
pathTypes.A: First -1 crossing by15m, later different bar +1 crossing
pathTypes.B: First -1 crossing by15m, no later +1, session-end close <=-1
pathTypes.E: First +1 later than30m and session-end close>0
pathTypes.G: Incomplete path or first +1/-1 crossings same bar; no inferred intrabar order

selectedFrozenReplay: P23.8D STATE_MONOTONIC_RATCHET_V1 only; selected by reproducibility/architecture before paths, not outcome. simulateFrozenRatchetExit(row) with no overrides.
replayEligibility: Complete regular session path after Entry and complete same-day regular context from open to Entry, nonempty. Missing context/path -> NOT_REPRODUCIBLE for that event, never synthetic SESSION_OR_DATA_END. All277 retained in denominator.
adapter: LONG-only guard; map availableAtJst to timestamp and OHLCV fields; context completed<=Entry, future bar start>=Entry; IDs unchanged. No strategy logic changes.
replayIntrabar: Pre-bar stops only. Gap fill at open else stop touch at stop price as existing simulator. Intrabar holding reported interval; MAE-before-exit reported bound because exit-bar LOW order unknown.
capture: Gross exit return / full-session available MFE, unbounded and null if MFE<=0. Net ratio separately. Do not use built-in clamped pre-exit captureRatio for requested available-MFE measure.
existingV3V4: Inventory and compatibility only unless exact frozen analog pool, earlier-than-query eligibility and prior frozen Entry/universe responsibility proven. No new pool or Entry reconstruction.
